newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian drug maker Lek says H1 profit steady.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian drug maker Lek says H1 profit steady.

text.p: Slovenian drug maker Lek said first-half net profit was steady at 1.5 billion tolars ($11.4 million) while turnover rose to 20.3 billion from 17.2 billion in the same period of 1995.
"Our profit was unchanged mainly because prices of medicines are controlled by the government and have not changed in the past year and a half," deputy chief executive Simon Oblak told Reuters.

The half-year earnings news came only two days ahead of a new listing of Lek shares. The company plans to list an additional 1.7 million shares on the Ljubljana bourse on Wednesday, taking the total to 1.79 million or 92.7 percent of the firm's equity. -- Marja Novak, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
